units.old_text:
For an origin at $(0,0)$, let $W,H$ be page width and height and $b=(x_0,y_0,x_1,y_1)$ a selected box.
Its normalized coordinates are
\begin{equation}
  \widehat b=\left(\frac{x_0}{W},\frac{y_0}{H},\frac{x_1}{W},\frac{y_1}{H}\right).
units.new_text:
For page bounds $(x_{\min},y_{\min},x_{\max},y_{\max})$, let $b=(x_0,y_0,x_1,y_1)$ be a selected box.
Its normalized coordinates are
\begin{equation}
  \widehat b=\left(\frac{x_0-x_{\min}}{x_{\max}-x_{\min}},\frac{y_0-y_{\min}}{y_{\max}-y_{\min}},\frac{x_1-x_{\min}}{x_{\max}-x_{\min}},\frac{y_1-y_{\min}}{y_{\max}-y_{\min}}\right).

text.text: A note has a precise address
Mark a word, a symbol, or a region. A note keeps
its page and bounding box; an agent can use that
location to find the source. Normalized coordinates
let the same box follow the page as you zoom or resize.
